title: Best Beanie Baby (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were made by extracting product mentions from the provided PCMag, CNET, Good Housekeeping, and Cosmopolitan excerpts.
assumptions: No price details were included because the sources only gave original launch prices for the Princess Diana bear and auction starting bids for retired Webkinz items.

verdict.line: Buyers who want a historically significant and potentially valuable collectible should choose the Princess Diana Beanie Baby, as it was sold for $5‑7 in 1997 with proceeds to a memorial fund; its rarity and story give it strong resale appeal. The main catch is that its value depends on condition and proof of authenticity.
